guide:
USER-TAUGHT EDITING + SOUND RULES (measured on 10 reference videos: SaaS promos, cinematic title sequences, history explainers):
LOOK: one hero object per scene (60-70 % of the frame), rest supporting; one accent colour on a dark or soft-gradient background; tiny logo badge fixed in a corner; real-looking UI screenshots, never empty boxes; depth = blur on off-focus layers + scale difference; physical styles (paper, tape, polaroid, flat-lay) use shadows + slight rotation (-4..+4 deg).
RHYTHM: something new every 0.2-0.4 s in a hook, a new object/card about every 2-5 s; cuts every 2.5-5 s (long videos ~5 s); story colour change = story beat (dark = problem, light = solution).
MOTION: ease-out slides, overshoot 5-10 % on pops, cursor on a curved path with click squeeze, lines draw 0.6 s, camera glides/pushes slowly (never static for >3 s), whip-zoom blur or light-beam flash to change worlds, typewriter 0.16-0.33 s per character.
SOUND: every visual event has a hit - pop/click on each card or icon (spacing 0.2-0.85 s), one tick per typed character, whoosh on every transition / whip / camera glide, soft paper or tape sound for physical items, riser into a big reveal. Mix: music bed + effects around -16 dB RMS, peaks near -1 dBFS, bass-led (200-700 Hz) with clear highs for ticks; voice-over on top. Silent clips (4 of 10 had no audio) are made to get music + effects added afterwards.
TEXT: 1-2 lines, 2 sizes max, key word bold or coloured; handwriting font for a personal sentence with a yellow highlighter underline; numbers count up; strike-through old prices.
SFX CHEAT SHEET (from the owner's storyboard PDFs - every visible change has a sound, the loudest lands on the cut or the logo): text/object slide or camera push = short whoosh 0.2-0.5 s (long slide = soft air swish); icon/chip/badge appears = pop or bubble pop, pitch a little higher on each chip; typing/code/list = fast key tick per character or line; cursor click = mouse click then a tiny blip when the next state opens; big title slam or hard cut = impact or short boom, often with a reverse riser 0.5 s before; logo reveal = clean tone hit (+ low sub boom, sparkle shimmer); glitch/pixel dissolve/data bars = digital glitch burst; messages/notifications = sent whoosh + received ding; check mark = short ping (error line = buzz, then a fix chime); counter rolling = tick roll that speeds up and lands with a thud (money = cash ka-ching); calm hold / end card = quiet pad or silence so the logo feels premium.
EDIT RHYTHM: text scenes 1.5-3 s, UI mockup scenes 3-6 s, logo hold 1-3 s; elements enter ease-out with ~105 % overshoot then settle to 100 %; group items stagger 3-6 frames, never all at once; text blurs in ~0.3 s and key words get a colour or box; backgrounds stay simple (solid or one blurred glow); change visual or background colour every 2-3 s and flip light to dark on the biggest beat; ONE accent colour per video; max 12 words on screen per scene; cut on audio peaks (loudest peak = title, reveal or logo). Structure: hook 0-2 s, problem/question 2-5 s, UI mockup demo 5-14 s, proof/stat 14-20 s, CTA click 20-24 s, logo hold last 2 s.
STYLE PICKER: dark premium SaaS/AI = glow + glass UI + typing; loud neon hype = kinetic slams + HUD; clean white corporate = pills, hexagon badges, green/blue accent; personal brand = native UI controls (chat, calendar, iMessage) ; product UI story = cursor clicks; integrations = hub and spoke with line draws; pricing/ROI = calculator, strike-through, highlight slide; data story = tree/connector with stats and handwriting underline.

techniques.name: Highlighter bar behind the key word
techniques.how: yellow bar wipes in from the left behind the word in 0.3 s while the word slams in; marker SFX

techniques.name: Tilted 3D card grid with tabs
techniques.how: cards on a perspective plane, tab pills highlight in orange one by one, camera glides along the plane

techniques.name: Hub and spoke integrations
techniques.how: mascot or logo in the centre, curved lines draw out (trim path) and an app icon pops with a glow pulse at each line end, 4-6 frames stagger; soft whoosh as lines draw, pop per icon

techniques.name: Hard colour flip on the key word
techniques.when: problem to solution, big number, the word AI
techniques.how: whole screen inverts light to dark exactly on the beat with whoosh + short impact; use once per video on the biggest beat

techniques.name: Slot-wheel feature list
techniques.how: vertical list scrolls like a slot picker, centre item white and scaled up, others dim and blur at top and bottom, orange glow on the edges; rolling tick that slows as it settles

techniques.name: Prompt box typing with highlight chips
techniques.how: large glass prompt box, text types with caret, important words get coloured highlight boxes that pop behind them, enter-key icon bounces; typing ticks + click per highlight

techniques.name: Pill chips pile
techniques.how: rounded pill labels pop in one after another with a spring, alternating filled and outlined, rows wrap and shift as new ones arrive; bubble pop per chip, pitch rising

techniques.name: Hexagon badge with leader line
techniques.how: icon in a hexagon with bracket corners pops with a scale bounce, thin leader line draws to a label that fades in; pop per badge

techniques.name: Calculator counter payoff
techniques.how: calculator card with sliders, a huge number rolls up with motion blur, then money rains with rotation and blur; tick roll then cash register ding

techniques.name: Notification stack
techniques.how: phone notification pills drop in one by one with spring bounce and stack down, each with an app icon, a line and a green amount; phone ding per card

techniques.name: Pricing card highlight slide
techniques.how: plans in a row, a highlight pill slides to the best plan, button changes, old price strikes out and the new price pops; click + ding

techniques.name: Camera dive through a button
techniques.how: glass pill button, camera zooms through it and frosted dashboard cards burst outward in 3D with parallax and blur; big whoosh + UI blips

techniques.name: Blur wipe transition
techniques.when: scene change in glass or gradient styles
techniques.how: soft blurred gradient wipes across the frame (sky blue, purple) while the next element rises from the bottom edge; airy whoosh

techniques.name: Chromatic aberration speed text
techniques.how: text stretched horizontally with motion blur and red/blue colour fringing slides in fast then snaps sharp; speed whoosh + tape stop

techniques.name: Variable-font morph
techniques.how: letters change weight and shape per letter with a little blur like a variable font; short flutter sound

techniques.name: Native UI controls scenes
techniques.how: each scene is a real-feeling control: iMessage bubbles, segmented control sliding, stepper counting, carousel with arrows and a cursor click, calendar scroll; matching click or pop for each

techniques.name: Glitch terminal text
techniques.how: monospace line types and characters scramble before settling, dot-matrix background; rapid key ticks + digital glitch blip

techniques.name: Debug pass with checkmarks
techniques.how: zoom into a code window, lines get green checks one by one, one red error line shakes then is fixed; check ping per line, error buzz, fix chime

techniques.name: Branching tree growth
techniques.when: data labels, many items becoming one idea
techniques.how: one line splits into many curves with nodes at the tips (trim path), or labels grow into a hand-drawn tree; growth whoosh + soft chimes

techniques.name: Glossy 3D end phrase
techniques.how: giant chrome or glass text scales from heavy blur to sharp with a light sweep across it; big cinematic hit + shimmer tail

techniques.name: Bookend hook and CTA
techniques.how: first screen: short hook with a hand-drawn underline swoosh; last screen: two lines with a glowing gradient second line (ORDER NOW) with a slow pulse; whoosh on the wipe, sparkle on the CTA
